full_description: In the KitchenS scene (no sink or microwave), the stove is already on. Raw food starts on a chopping board. Put the food into the pan, cook to the food's ideal doneness (meat medium, sausage dark-red, onion browned), then turn the stove knob off. Success is adequate doneness after the stove is off; leave the food in the pan.
